# arcane_api_resources (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cluster scoped api resource
data "arcane_api_resources" "ns" {
  api_version = "v1"
  kind        = "Namespace"
}

# Namespaced api resource
data "arcane_api_resources" "pod" {
  api_version = "v1"
  kind        = "Pod"
  namespace   = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) API version of the resource (e.g., 'v1' or 'apps/v1')
- `kind` (String) Kind of the resource (e.g., 'ConfigMap', 'Deployment')

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace to list. Omit it for a cluster-scoped kind, or to list a namespaced kind across all namespaces.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) API path of the resource list
- `objects` (Dynamic) Resource objects returned by the API server, as a tuple of object values. Unlike `live_object` of the `arcane_api_resource` resource, they keep `metadata.managedFields`, `metadata.resourceVersion`, `metadata.updateTimestamp` and `metadata.generation`. Earlier provider versions returned a list of YAML strings, so replace `yamldecode(...)` with direct references such as `data.arcane_api_resources.x.objects[0].metadata.name`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
